item.text: {"answers":[{"case_id":"modes-en-061","text":"Thanks for letting us know about the wobbling table, Sam. We’ve asked the workshop to inspect it. We don’t yet know whether it can be repaired, but we’ll share the inspection findings as soon as we receive them."},{"case_id":"modes-en-062","text":"Our basil is a tiny green landlord ruling the windowsill. Six new leaves counted this week—not a growth record; we didn’t count last week’s. Rent payable in sunlight."},{"case_id":"modes-en-063","text":"I’m sorry for the delay. I entered the wrong delivery address, and the warehouse used the address I supplied. I’ve asked the carrier whether rerouting is possible and am still waiting for a reply."},{"case_id":"modes-en-064","text":"Two bicycles were found beside the pool after closing and are stored in the caretaker’s shed. Their owners are unknown, and we do not know whether they were left deliberately. Owners may contact the desk and describe their bicycle before collecting it."},{"case_id":"modes-en-065","text":"“I could take the early ferry,” Mara said, “if the wind drops.
